newsitem.title: USA: Unysis has no comment on stock rise.
newsitem.headline: Unysis has no comment on stock rise.

text.p: Unisys Corp had no comment Friday on a 16 percent surge in the value of its shares, which coincided with a general rout in U.S. stocks.

"We don't comment on market activity," said corporate spokesman Peter Hynes. In mid-afternoon trading, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average off more than 100 points, Unisys shares were up 1-1/2 at 11-1/8.

The stock had been rising since the company posted better-than-expected earnings on July 21. On Thursday, Prudential Securities upgraded the stock to a buy from a hold. The upgrade followed a similar move by Buckingham Research.
